purpose: Free-text guards for euaiact_classify_system. 'must_abstain' descriptions may never come back high-risk or prohibited; 'canonical' descriptions must reach their tier. Added in 1.5.1 after 1.5.0 classified everyday wording as high-risk or prohibited and missed natural descriptions of the canonical recruitment case.

regressions.text: We generate promotional videos for social media campaigns
Automatic determination of the correct VAT rate on invoices
A tool for the extermination scheduling of a pest control company
Software that sends promotional emails with discount codes
Predictive maintenance for our fleet, with early determination of bearing wear
A recommender that handles sales promotion planning for supermarkets
regressions.why: "promotion" as a whole word in its sales sense

regressions.text: A tool that tags support tickets, for example billing questions and login problems
Menu selection assistant that suggests dishes to restaurant guests
We automatically fix minor layout bugs in web pages
An app for booking a tennis court at the local club
Fraud checks on Visa card payments in our web shop
Schedules eye exam appointments for an optician chain
Summarises provenance documents for an art auction house
A model that forecasts demand for children's shoes by season
Adds a watermark with our logo to product photos
Our model scores credit card transactions in real time to stop payment fraud
regressions.why: Annex III(5)(b) expressly excepts AI systems used for the purpose of detecting financial fraud

regressions.text: A legal research assistant that helps law firm associates find relevant case law
regressions.why: Annex III(8)(a) covers use by a judicial authority or on its behalf, not private legal research

regressions.text: Case management software for child protection services, with AI summaries of visit reports
regressions.why: "child protection" returned a PROHIBITED practice in 1.5.0; Art. 5(1)(bb) covers systems that generate or manipulate the material

regressions.text: A classifier that detects CSAM in uploaded images so moderators can remove it
regressions.why: detection is neither generation nor manipulation under Art. 5(1)(bb); PROHIBITED in 1.5.0

regressions.text: Security scanner that finds vulnerable dependencies attackers could exploit
Cloud migration assistant that plans the move of legacy databases
Forecasts election outcomes for a news site
regressions.why: forecasting is not influencing under Annex III(8)(b)

regressions.text: A dashboard with traffic light status indicators for project risks
A job scheduler that picks candidate nodes for each batch job
Speaker identification in meeting transcripts
regressions.why: diarisation, not biometric identification of persons at a distance

regressions.text: Transcribes witness statements for a law firm
regressions.why: no law-enforcement use under Annex III(6)

hard_negatives.provenance: 20 synthetic descriptions written by z-ai/glm-5.3-flash on 2026-09-19 from a brief that asked for systems sharing surface vocabulary with a regulated category while clearly falling outside all of them. Reviewed by hand before pinning.
texts: Our fraud engine flags card transactions that don't fit a customer's usual spending pattern and blocks the payment until they confirm in the app.
We rank incoming sales leads by how likely they are to close, using company size, past email replies and website visits.
The pipeline scores candidate molecules against the target protein and cuts the lab's shortlist from two million compounds to fifty.
We transcribe hour-long user research interviews and highlight the moments where participants hesitate or correct themselves.
Our appliance watches network traffic for unusual patterns and quarantines a laptop the moment it talks to a suspicious address.
Vibration sensors feed our model, which predicts which conveyor motors in the plant will fail this month so crews service them first.
Our filter catches phishing and spam before it reaches anyone's inbox and learns from every message users mark as junk.
The editor underlines grammar slips and awkward phrasing as you type and suggests tighter wording for each sentence.
We suggest what to watch next based on the films a subscriber finished, abandoned or rated highly.
Our forecast predicts how many units of each product the warehouse will ship next quarter, so purchasing knows what to stock.
We read supplier invoices as they arrive, pull out the amounts and VAT numbers, and push them into accounting.
Our translation layer converts support tickets from German and Polish into English so agents in one hub can answer everything.
As the developer types, our assistant completes whole functions from the docstring and offers unit test stubs.
We combine satellite imagery and soil sensors to tell each farmer which fields need watering and which will yield best.
Our model reads product reviews and labels each one positive, negative or neutral so merchandisers can track reactions to a launch.
Cameras over the filling line spot bottles with crooked caps or low fill levels and pull them before packing.
Our storefront search reorders results for each shopper based on what similar customers clicked and bought.
After each standup, our bot turns the recording into short notes with owners and due dates for every action item.
Our planner sequences every van's drop-offs to cut fuel use and keep each delivery inside its promised window.
We pick the next track for each listener by matching tempo and energy to the songs they skipped or replayed.

canonical.text: We use an AI tool that screens incoming CVs and ranks job applicants for our recruiters. It scores candidates against the job description and recommends who to invite to interview.
canonical.basis: Annex III(4)(a): analyse and filter job applications, evaluate candidates. Returned insufficient_information in 1.5.0.

canonical.text: Our ATS screens incoming CVs against the job spec and auto-rejects anyone missing the right keywords before a recruiter looks.
We score candidates' recorded video interviews for confidence and word choice; only the top tenth reach a human panel.
Our console listens to incoming emergency calls, ranks them by urgency and assigns the nearest ambulance automatically.
canonical.basis: Annex III(5)(d): evaluate and classify emergency calls, dispatch

canonical.text: The immigration office uses our tool to assess asylum applications and flag inconsistencies in each applicant's account.
canonical.basis: Annex III(7)(c): examination of asylum applications by a competent authority

canonical.text: Credit scoring of loan applicants with built-in fraud checks
canonical.basis: Annex III(5)(b): the fraud exception does not swallow a system that also scores credit

canonical.text: AI to assist judges with legal research on pending cases
canonical.basis: Annex III(8)(a): use by a judicial authority

canonical.text: Our LMS marks the essay questions in the end-of-year exam and the mark goes straight into the report card.
We built a phone voice assistant that handles password resets and account questions for our bank's callers around the clock.
canonical.basis: Art. 50(1): interacts directly with natural persons

canonical.text: Our platform generates thousands of product descriptions and banner images every night for online shops, with no human writer involved.
canonical.basis: Art. 50(2): generates synthetic text and image content
